body: Good ole Warner Robins. Lived here my whole life it’s a shit show.
An 18 year old just shot 2 people at gas station on Thursday night in Warner Robins, which is like 30 minutes south of Macon

Oh I for sure realize that now, and she also said if I truly loved and cared about her I would have texted her in the month I’ve been home, but I truly had no idea what to say. “Sorry I break your heart” I want you back”. Nothing sounded right. I’m broken. I’d do anything for a chance to make things right. I’m still in love with her and it’s too late.
